answer: At an observatory, visitors wander past crystal exhibits to see a comet. Its booking market gives each verified operator one daily request budget across all their agents. A registrar checks identity and prior enrollment before signing a credential. Validators verify credential-bound signatures, require today's date, reject reused request IDs and enforce the operator's shared cap. Replacement credentials retain prior usage. Extra accounts add no capacity: attackers must recruit more verified operators. This trusts the registrar and does not prevent collusion or credential theft.
